ChapterGoalKey figuresEnds when
2 — Icewind DaleExplore the Dale, pick up an Arcane Brotherhood patron, find the road to Sunblight.Vellynne Harpell, Avarice, Dzaan's Simulacrum, Nass Lantomir's GhostThe party learns Xardorok is building something.
3 — SunblightInfiltrate the duergar fortress under Sunblight.Xardorok Sunblight, Grandolpha Muzgardt, Krob, F'yorlThe chardalyn dragon launches — whether or not the party is ready.
4 — Destruction's LightChase and stop the chardalyn dragon before it levels Ten-Towns.Chardalyn Dragon, Vellynne HarpellThe dragon is destroyed. Ten-Towns counts its dead.
5 — Auril's AbodeReach Solstice and break one of Auril's three forms.Auril (three forms), Gunvald Halraggson, Bjornhild Solvigsdottir, Isarr KronenstromAuril is beaten, or the party flees the island.
6 — Caves of HungerDescend toward the buried city.Tekeli-li, Yilsebek Dalambra, Hengar Aesnvaard, MjenirThe party reaches Ythryn.
7 — Doom of YthrynExplore the fallen Netherese city and deal with the Arch-Astronomer.Iriolarthas, Scrivenscry, Veneranda, the night hag covenThe mythallar's fate is decided. Roll credits.

Recurring threads

  • The Arcane Brotherhood — Vellynne, Avarice, Dzaan and Nass Lantomir all want the Codicil of White. Only one can be the party's ally.
  • Auril's winter — the sun does not rise until the campaign says it does. Roll on Weather — The Everlasting Rime each dawn.
  • Character secrets — each PC gets one from Appendix B. Vokarr the Eyebiter and Beldora are built for two of them.
